climatology_alignment.operation_order: interpolate each yearly native-ensemble mean, aggregate seven lead days, then equally average 20 years

region_definition.name: IMD four broad homogeneous rainfall regions

geometry_source.name: Survey of India Administrative Boundary Database (ABDB)
geometry_source.display_note: Presentation reference only; not a substitute for an official legal or cadastral boundary determination.

region_definition.aggregation: cos(latitude) multiplied by state/UT polygon coverage estimated from a deterministic 20-by-20 subcell mask within each native grid cell
region_definition.interpretation: The four-region grouping follows IMD reporting. Display masks are derived from Survey of India state/UT geometry, not an IMD subdivision shapefile.

probability_definition.below_normal: percentage of 100 forecast members strictly below the lower tercile
probability_definition.near_normal: percentage of members at or between the two terciles
probability_definition.above_normal: percentage of members strictly above the upper tercile
probability_definition.terciles: 1/3 and 2/3 quantiles across 20 equally weighted yearly native-ensemble means
probability_definition.warning: Raw ensemble guidance, not a calibrated operational probability or warning.
